cases.command:
set -e
python qa-swig-app.py before
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends swig
swig -python qa_swig.i
gcc -shared -fPIC $(python3-config --includes) qa_swig_wrap.c -o _qa_swig$(python3-config --extension-suffix)
python qa-swig-app.py build
python qa-swig-app.py serve > own-server.log 2>&1 &
qa_swig_pid=$!
trap 'kill "$qa_swig_pid" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
python check.py
cat own-server.log
